app.title: StyleGuard
app.promise: The document's text is never rewritten. Only blank space is removed, and only when the rules ask for it. Images, tables and charts stay.
mate.heuristic_only: Rule extraction: regex heuristic. Connect an LLM agent for better results (`MATE_BASE_URL`, `MATE_PAT`).
editor.headings_empty: No heading level is defined — headings will not be formatted.
editor.keywords_help: This is how the document is split into sections. If `body_start` does not match the heading your thesis starts its main part with, formatting stops with an error.
format.library_empty: The library is empty. Extract rules from a style guide and save them.
format.unresolved: {count} fields were not found in the style guide (marked ⚠️). Fill them in or leave them empty — an empty field means that property is left alone.
format.lenient: Continue even if the structure is not recognised
extract.match_found: A similar set was found in the library
extract.match_details: The library already holds **{name}** (match {score}). You can use it instead of extracting again.
extract.rejected: Rules discarded because their quote is not in the style guide: {fields}
save.requires_login: Saving rules requires signing in — a set has to belong to someone. Without signing in you can download them as JSON and import them later.
save.foreign: „{name}” belongs to someone else — saving creates your own copy.
save.name: Name
report.dry_run: *** DRY RUN — the document was not modified ***
library.anonymous: You can browse and use the library without signing in. To save or change rules, sign in — every set belongs to whoever created it.
library.admin: Admin: you can edit and delete every set.
library.empty: The library is empty. On the *Format a document* page, extract rules from a style guide and save them — the next thesis from the same faculty will then use them without extracting again.
library.col.name: name
library.name: Name
auth.gate_caption: Access to this app is password protected.
auth.local_mode: Local mode — sign-in is not configured, everything is permitted.
auth.sign_in_hint:
Formatting works without signing in.

Sign in to save rules.
auth.perm.sign_in: Sign in to save and edit rules.
auth.perm.copy_hint: {whose} Make a copy to edit it.
error.no_text_layer: '{filename}' has no text layer ({chars} characters found). It is probably a scan. Pick a set from the library or enter the rules by hand.
error.unsupported_format: Unsupported style guide format: '{suffix}'. Supported: .pdf and .docx.
mate.not_configured: MATE_PAT is not set. Create a Personal Access Token in the agent dashboard (the user needs the 'admin' or 'developer' role) and put it in MATE_PAT.
mate.auth_failed: The agent server rejected authentication ({status}). Check MATE_PAT and that the user has the 'admin' or 'developer' role. Detail: {detail}
mate.agent_not_exposed: Agent '{agent}' is not reachable on the /v1 route. In the dashboard the agent must have 'expose_as_model' enabled, be a root agent (no parents), and not be disabled. Detail: {detail}
mate.http_error: The agent server returned HTTP {status}. Detail: {detail}
mate.unreachable: The agent server is unreachable at {url}: {error}
mate.call_failed: The call to the agent failed: {error}
mate.bad_response: Unexpected response shape from the agent: {body}
mate.agent_missing: The agent server is reachable, but '{agent}' is not among the exposed models ({models}).
pipeline.sending: Sending the style guide to the agent…
pipeline.repairing: The reply failed validation — asking for a correction…
pipeline.falling_back: Falling back to the regex heuristic…
pipeline.no_agent: No agent configured — using the regex heuristic…
pipeline.institution_heuristic: The institution was identified by the heuristic, not the agent.
pipeline.rejected: {count} rules were discarded because their quote is not in the style guide: {fields}
pipeline.bad_json: The agent did not return usable JSON: {error}
pipeline.invalid_json: The reply is not valid JSON: {error}
pipeline.no_json: The reply contains no JSON object.
structure.body_not_found: The start of the main text was not found. Expected keywords: {keywords}. {hint} Add the heading this document starts its main part with to `structure_profile.section_keywords.body_start`.
structure.hint_outline: The document uses Word heading styles.
structure.hint_no_outline: The document has no Word heading styles, so detection relies on heading numbering alone.
engine.section_missing: Section {section} was not found in the document. The rules expect it by keyword ({keywords}), but the document names it differently. Its content has been attributed to the preceding section and takes that section's rules — extend `structure_profile.section_keywords`.
engine.dry_run_note: A dry run reports deletions only; style changes are not counted.
cleanup.empty_paragraph_with_break: empty paragraph with a manual page break
cleanup.reason.has_content: contains an image, field, footnote or other embedded content
